The '''Serathrace sector''' was located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="Slice" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it bordered the [[Belasco sector/Legends|Belasco sector]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]], the [[Tolemses sector/Legends|Tolemses sector]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]], and the [[Axion sector/Legends|Axion sector]] [[spinward]]. The [[Sector/Legends|sector]] also formed a four-way border with the [[Askarian sector/Legends|Askarian sector]], the [[Hangshan sector/Legends|Hangshan sector]], and the [[Harron Marches/Legends|Harron Marches]] at its [[trailing]] edge.<ref name="Expansion" /> The Serathrace sector contained the [[Batravia system/Legends|Batravia system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which was the origin point of [[Batravian gumplucker]]s.<ref name="Luke">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Batravian gumplucker]]s|system=[[Batravia system/Legends|Batravia system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Serathrace sector was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EAOC" /> The sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the [[2012]] StarWars.com article "[https://web.archive.org/web/20170806141020/http://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region]," which placed it in grid square P-11.<ref name="Expansion" />
